theme: dark and light mode (System preferred, default dark)

rules: Use Outfit for H1-H4. Apply tracking-tight for sizes above 24px.
Use IBM Plex Sans for all body text, paragraphs, and descriptions.
Use JetBrains Mono for metadata, tags, match scores, days remaining, and table data. This creates a developer-focused, technical aesthetic.
NEVER use generic fonts like Inter or Roboto for headings.
Do NOT use dozen gradient cards. Stick to flat, solid colors with very subtle 1px borders.
Accent color (Electric Blue/Cyan) should be used SPARINGLY to draw attention (e.g., Match Score rings, active tab indicators, primary buttons).
Use 'urgent' color for 'Closing Soon' tags or deadlines < 3 days.

visual_enhancers.shadows: Minimal. Rely on 1px borders (border-collapse style) rather than heavy drop shadows to define structure.
visual_enhancers.borders: 1px solid borders everywhere for that technical, high-information-density look.
visual_enhancers.radius: Slight. rounded-md (6px) or rounded-sm (4px). Avoid fully rounded pills unless it's a specific tag.
visual_enhancers.textures: Include a subtle noise overlay on the dark theme background to reduce flatness.

opportunity_card.style: High-density rectangle, not a fluffy card. Grid layout inside the card.
elements: Header: Organization name + Verification Shield icon.
Title: H3/H4 size, truncate to 2 lines.
Match Score: prominently displayed, perhaps a small circular SVG ring or a bold mono percentage text.
Metadata row: Location, Remote indicator, Funding.
Footer: Deadline (mono font, urgency color if near), Save button (Lucide Bookmark).

badges.style: Uppercase, mono font, tiny text (text-xs), wide tracking (tracking-widest).

onboarding.style: Clean, distraction-free central column. Progress indicator at the top using a thin line or minimal steps.

navigation.style: Side navigation for dashboard. Icons (Lucide) + Text. Active state indicated by a left 2px border in accent color.

layouts.marketing: Asymmetrical bento-style grid for features. Hero section should feel like a command center.
layouts.dashboard: High-density grid. md:grid-cols-3 lg:grid-cols-4 for tiles. 'For You' feed takes up main column (col-span-2 or 3), right sidebar for 'Closing Soon' or 'Saved' summaries.

rules: Subtle and purposeful. No bouncy or excessive animations.
Hover states: Change border color and background slightly. Do NOT lift the card (no -translate-y).

icons.rules: Use Lucide icons exclusively. Do NOT use emojis for any UI element.

hero_background.description: Abstract blue glowing dots forming wave patterns, used as a low-opacity background for the landing page hero.

student_persona.description: Student coding in a dark room with monitors, used in marketing or onboarding sections.

charts: for ingestion status dashboard if needed

instructions_to_main_agent: Build standard React components (.js/.jsx) using Tailwind CSS. NO Next.js.
Implement a theme toggle (light/dark) in the UI.
Prioritize information density on the dashboard. Use tables and tight grids.
Ensure 'Match Score' is visually prominent using the accent color.
Do NOT use generic gradient cards. Use flat surfaces with precise 1px borders.
Add data-testid attributes to all interactive elements.
UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: Do not converge toward generic AI slop. Make it look like a premium developer tool (think Vercel, Linear, or Raycast).
Use glass-morphism effects with backdrop-blur only where appropriate (like sticky headers).
Do not center-align the app container. Keep text left-aligned for natural reading.
Every interaction needs micro-animations - hover states, focus rings.
Never use AI assistant Emoji characters like 🤖🧠💭💡🔮🎯 etc for icons. Use Lucide.
